title: Yield Enhancement SEM & ETM Process Shift Technician
description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

Job Summary:  

Micron Technology is seeking driven and thorough Yield Enhancement Failure Analysis (YE FA) Lab SEM & ETM Process Technicians. In this role, you will perform inline targeting procedures using SEM (Scanning Electron Microscope) and ETM tools (including Exsolve, TEM Link, and Metrios) to capture high-quality images. These procedures will follow either customized customer instructions or standardized protocols.  As a key contributor to the world’s leading memory and storage solutions provider, you will be at the forefront of innovation. This position requires a strong sense of responsibility and enthusiasm, reflecting Micron’s core values: People, Innovation, Tenacity, Collaboration, and Customer Focus.  

Responsibilities:  

  • Performs SEM analysis requests following detailed instructions, applying basic cross-sectioning techniques for sample preparation and ETM analysis. 

  • Prioritizes SEM and ETM tasks based on the current request queue, coordinating with supervisors to adjust priorities when necessary. 

  • Collaborate with customers, peers, and supervisors to clarify instructions and ensure accurate, targeted results. 

  • Completes analysis requests by interpreting collected data and providing well-supported conclusions. 

  • Certified and trained to operate all necessary lab equipment for SEM and ETM analysis, while strictly adhering to safety protocols. 

  • Proactively identifies and reports minor equipment issues to prevent major disruptions, supporting overall lab efficiency. 

  • Maintains all required training certifications in accordance with area guidelines. 

  • Keeps up-to-date technical knowledge of device structures and functions for both current and upcoming components. 

  • Recommends process improvements and partners with leadership to implement effective changes. 

  • Actively shares knowledge and insights to support team collaboration and continuous learning. 

 AI-Enabled Analysis and Productivity

  • Utilizes approved AI and digital productivity tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot) to improve efficiency in data analysis, report generation, knowledge retrieval, and problem-solving activities.

  • Leverages AI tools to accelerate documentation, communication, and investigation workflows while maintaining data accuracy and engineering judgment.

  • Demonstrates responsible use of AI technologies in accordance with company policies, data protection requirements, and intellectual property safeguards.

Minimum Requirements:   

  • High school diploma or equivalent.  

  • Flexibility to work 12-hour shifts (3 on/4 off and 4 on/3 off) and be willing to move to different shifts and work overtime to support business operations.  

  • The ability to always wear lab-specific clean room garments (100%) to prevent human contamination of products, and occasionally wear PPE (Personal Protective Equipment), such as a chemical apron and face shield (approximately 1% of the time).  

 

Preferred Requirements:  

  • AAS or AS Degree in Mechatronics, Electronics, Mechanical Engineering, Science, Physics, Mathematics, or Supply Chain Management (or equivalent trade school/military experience) 

  • 2+ years of industry experience; or equivalent military training and experience​​  

  • 2+ year experience identifying performance gaps and implementing strategic improvements.  

  • Experience working within a lab environment
